chapter.heading: Psalm 131Childlike Trust in the Lord.A Song of Ascents. Of David.
chapter.v:
Lord, my
heart is not proud, nor my eyes haughty;Nor do I involve myself in great matters,Or in things too difficult for me.

Surely I
have calmed and quieted my soul;Like a weaned child [resting] with his mother,My soul is like a weaned child within me [composed and freed from discontent].

O Israel,
hope in the LordFrom this time forth and forever.
